- The Costumes eligible for bonuses during the Season Event from September 10 to September 22 are as follows:

3. Slice of Life - Firechip

4. Tenka Izumo Special Skin Update
- A special skin, “Special Date Tenka Izumo,” which allows you to change the appearance of the Ame-no-Mitori Tenka Izumo Costume will be added.
- The Tenka Izumo Special Skin can be purchased from the Skin tab on the right side of the Home screen.

Tapping this button will open the skin change pop-up.

- You can now recharge your daily number of encounters with Fated Guests up to 3 times using Dias or Deco Coins.

ㄴ The target score can be set in 1-point increments, and the maximum number of consecutive refining attempts has been increased from 1,000 to 5,000.

- You can now set a different background for each costume on the Costume Information / Change screens.
ㄴ In Silhouette Mode, the background associated with the corresponding costume will be displayed.

- The number of free daily attempts for the Tower of Salvation has been increased from 3 to 10.

- The Guidebook has been improved so that you can close it from the first page without having to view the final page.

- Support Characters can now be used on all difficulty levels in Master Packs, Story Packs, Character Packs, and Event Packs.
ㄴ Please note that Support Characters can also be used in stages on the Very Hard difficulty.

- Home Screen → Story Scenes will now be sorted in chronological story order.
ㄴ The most recent story will be categorized under the Master Pack, with Master Pack-related scenes displayed first.

- Thumbnails of the content where each BGM is used will now be added to BGM tracks, excluding songs that are shared across multiple content.

- Stickers in the Special category will be divided into four tabs.
ㄴ Special: Stickers obtained or provided through events and other means
ㄴ Content: Stickers provided through specific content, such as Last Night, Mirror Wars, and Fiend Hunter
ㄴ Emotes: Stickers based on emotes
ㄴ Sound Effects: Stickers based on sound effects

- Rankings for each minigame in the Arcade will be removed, and your ranking compared to all users will instead be displayed as a percentile.

First, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the Fiend Hunter Error Season.

We would like to provide details regarding the compensation for Fiend Hunter Season 77: Chimera of Resentment, which has been processed as an Error Season, as well as the reset and refund support for Potential Liberation, Burst upgrade, and related growth resources used to prepare for this season.
Please see below for more details.
[Fiend Hunter Apology Compensation]
■ Eligible Players
Players who participated in Fiend Hunter at least once during the hunting period of Fiend Hunter Season 77
■ Compensation
Refining Powder x300,000
Gold x800,000
■ Claim Period
After the September 22, 2026 maintenance – September 29, 2026, 2:59 PM (UTC)
※ If you do not see the reward in your mailbox, please fully close the game and log in again.
Refining Powder is a resource whose usage results are permanently reflected through equipment growth and refinement records.
Therefore, individual refunds based on the amount used will not be provided.

However, considering that additional refinement costs may have occurred while preparing for the Error Season, we will provide 300,000 Refining Powder to all Masters who participated in Fiend Hunter Season 77.
On the other hand, Refining Crystals replace existing options with new ones each time they are used, leaving only the final selected option.
In particular, for players who changed gear options to prepare for Fiend Hunter, we determined that it would be difficult to preserve the effects of the Refining Crystals used during this season.
Therefore, Refining Crystals will be refunded individually after checking the actual amount used during the relevant period.
[Option Refinement Compensation]
■ Eligible Players
Players who participated in Fiend Hunter at least once during the hunting period of Fiend Hunter Season 77
■ Compensation Details
We will check the resources used for Option Refinement from after the August 26, 2026 maintenance until before September 7, 2026, 9:40 AM UTC, and provide refunds accordingly.
■ Claim Period
After the September 22, 2026 maintenance – September 29, 2026, 2:59 PM (UTC)
※ If you do not see the reward in your mailbox, please fully close the game and log in again.
[Character Growth Reset and Resource Refund]
■ Eligible Players
Players who participated in Fiend Hunter and performed any of the following between the August 26, 2026 maintenance and September 7, 2026, 9:40 AM UTC:
※ Potential Liberation / Burst Upgrade
■ Support Details
The following progress made during the above period will be reset and refunded:
- Potential Liberation progress made during the period will be reset.
- Burst Upgrade progress made during the period will be reset.
- All resources used for Potential Unlocks and Burst Upgrades will be fully refunded.
■ Restoration Example
The example below is provided to help explain the process. Actual restoration will be applied individually based on the costumes submitted through the application form.
※ Restoration will be based on the state immediately after the August 26, 2026 maintenance.
※ Potential resources used during the period will be refunded according to the restored stage.
※ Due to the full Burst reset conducted during the August 26, 2026 maintenance, all costumes will be reset to a state with no Burst upgrades.
※ Restoration will only be applied to the specific costumes submitted through the application form. Costumes that are not submitted will not be eligible for restoration.
[Application Method and Period]
Application Period: From the time this notice is posted until September 16, 2026, 2:59 PM UTC
How to Apply: Please submit your request through the application form below.
▶ Potential and Burst Upgrade Reset Application Form
※ The reset of enhancement progress and refund of used resources will be carried out during the September 22, 2026 maintenance.
※ Only requests submitted within the application period will be processed. If you are eligible, please make sure to submit your request within the period.
Once again, we sincerely apologize to all Masters who experienced inconvenience due to this issue.
We will do our best to improve stability and prevent similar issues from occurring again.
Thank you.

paragraphs: Full Burst RPG —BrownDust2.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience experienced during the Fiend Hunt content. Please see below for the confirmed issue and action plan regarding Season 77's giant fiend, Chimera of Resentment.
■ Issue

* When 3 or more chains are stacked on a weak spot, all body parts should receive guaranteed critical damage at the end of the fiend's turn. However, a bug has been identified where this guaranteed critical damage fails to apply correctly at the end of the fiend's turn.
■ Action Plan
Due to the above issue, Season 77 of Fiend Hunt will be designated as an "Error Season" and handled as follows:
1. Ranked Rewards: Sticker and trophy rewards will not be distributed.
2. Other Season Rewards: All Masters who participated in Fiend Hunt will receive season rewards adjusted to their personal best ranking.
3. Level Clear Rewards: Masters who were unable to clear stages below Level 15 will also receive the corresponding rewards for those stages.
4. Potential Awakening and Burst upgrades used in preparation for this season will be fully refunded.
■ Return Season

A separate return season will be held after the fix is applied, giving all Masters another opportunity to challenge the fiend. More details on the return season and resource refunds will be provided in a follow-up announcement.
We will do our best to resolve this as quickly as possible.

news.body: Hello, this is SooYeon Kim, Game Director of BrownDust2.I had the chance to briefly introduce myself to all of you during the July 23 livestream.Did you enjoy the broadcast?Getting to spend the entire show together with our Masters made it a truly memorable experience for me.I was also especially thrilled that we could finally reveal the new collaboration so many of you have been waiting for.I know I still have a lot to learn, but I’ll continue doing my best to help make BrownDust2 an even more enjoyable experience for all of you.Now, let’s take a look at what’s coming in this update.BrownDust2’s fourth collaboration is...『Chained Soldier 2』!!The anime Chained Soldier 2 is set in Mato, an otherworldly realm where fierce battles unfold.The series has won over fans with its distinctive cast of powerful characters, intense action, and gripping story.For this collaboration, we wanted to bring the appeal of Chained Soldier 2 into BrownDust2 in a way that feels distinctly our own.Our goal is to give longtime fans a fresh take on the characters they love, while also giving BrownDust2 Masters something completely new to enjoy.The Chained Soldier 2 collaboration will run for approximately four weeks, from September 10 to October 7 (UTC).Three characters from the series will be joining BrownDust2 as playable characters for the collaboration:Kyouka Uzen, Tenka Izumo, and Ren Yamashiro.New Characters & Costumes■ Kyouka UzenFirst up is Kyouka Uzen, commander of the Demon Defense Force's 7th Squad and wielder of Eternal Chains.After the Shuuki destroyed her hometown, Kyouka devoted herself to wiping them out and set her sights on becoming Supreme Commander of the Demon Defense Force.■ Tenka IzumoNext is Tenka Izumo, commander of the Demon Defense Force's 6th Squad and wielder of Ame-no-Mitori.Don't let her easygoing demeanor fool you. Her ability gives her terrifying control over space itself, allowing her to tear through both her enemies and the space around them.■ Ren YamashiroLast is Ren Yamashiro, commander of the 10th Squad, Supreme Commander of the Demon Defense Force, and wielder of Lord of the Cosmos.Her strength is on an entirely different level, earning her the title of "Earth's Answer" in the series.All three will be joining BrownDust2 as new characters, along with their respective costumes.These will all be limited collaboration costumes, available exclusively during the collaboration event.We'll also be giving out six copies of Kyouka Uzen's costume for free.In addition, Kyouka Uzen's exclusive UR gear, as well as the exclusive SR gear for all three collaboration costumes, will be available for free.How to obtain Costume / Exclusive Gear by CharacterCharacter and Costume Information※ Pickup costumes and periods are subject to change, and these costumes may be resold or distributed through various channels in the future.September Pickup InformationCollaboration Event Pack: Chained Soldier 2The collaboration brings a brand-new Event Pack, Chained Soldier 2.The story is set after Story Pack 20 but before Master Pack 1, so Master will not appear during the event.After leaving the Black Gallery, Justia and her companions try to pass through Taros Mine on their way to Ghenar.However, mysterious fiends appear and block their path.Just as the party realizes that none of their attacks have any effect, Kyouka Uzen, commander of the Demon Defense Force's 7th Squad, appears before them.What awaits Justia and her party after crossing paths with the Demon Defense Force? We hope you're looking forward to finding out!While they won’t be available as costumes in this collaboration, members of the 7th and 6th Squads will still appear as NPCs.Be sure to keep an eye out for Himari Azuma, Shushu Suruga, Nei Ookawamura, Yachiho Azuma, and Sahara Wakasa throughout the Event Pack!Season EventTwo Season Events will run back-to-back during the collaboration, with each one Skin for Ren Yamashiro.This skin shows a very different side of Ren.■ Avatar■ Skill CutsceneCollaboration Costume AvatarsDuring the collaboration event, Fantasia Square avatars for the three Chained Soldier 2 characters will be purchasablefor either 1,000 Deco Coins or 2,000 Dia each.Please note that collaboration avatars cannot equip the shared avatar items normally available through Avatar Settings.Instead, they can only use the skin parts included with their respective Special Skins.There are no restrictions on their emotes, content access, or other avatar features.And finally, here's an early look at shots from Kyouka, Tenka, and Ren's skill cutscenes.With the collaboration content covered, let's move on to the rest of the updates coming in September.Character Pack 2 "Firechip" Slice of Life (Sep 10)New Slice of Life stories are coming to Character Pack 2 "Firechip."Look forward to catching up with familiar faces from Firechip, including Anastasia and Lecliss, and seeing what they've been up to.Mini Season Event (Sep 23)With autumn comes ripened harvests, a round full moon, and the return of our Mini Season Event.This time, Master will join the characters of Dragonhaven and Westwind Village as they celebrate the Full Moon Festival together.To mark the occasion, Master is invited to help make special moon rice cakes for the festival.Will everyone manage to make them both delicious and pretty? You'll have to see for yourself!We're also adding a set of quizzes based on details from the Slice of Life stories.There will be five character quizzes featuring Glacia, Helena, Dalvi, Sylvia, and Yuri.Complete the quizzes to earn currency, which can be exchanged for a variety of rewards in the Event Exchange (Dice Event).Guild Raid■ Rucersingha (Dark) (Sep 23)Starting September 23, Rucersingha categories.The new categories are Special, Rapport, Emoji, and SFX, making it easier to find what you're looking for.Friend Support for Very Hard Story Packs (Sep 10)You'll now be able to borrow costumes from friends across all Story Pack difficulty levels.This means friend costumes can also be used on Very Hard difficulty after the update.New Home Menu Sorting Options (Sep 10)New sorting options will be added to each tab of the Home Screen settings menu.In addition to the existing options, you'll be able to sort by things like most recent story or character, making it quicker to find exactly what you want for your Home Screen.Improved Home BGM Player (Sep 10)We're also improving how BGM album art is displayed on the Home Screen.Some tracks currently share generic album art based on the Pack they belong to.After the update, these tracks will instead display artwork that better reflects the content and theme they're actually associated with.2 New Sky Island Mermaid Avatars (Sep 10)Two new avatars will be available for purchase after completing the Flavia and Blanche fishing achievements in the new Sky Island fishing area.If you've already completed these achievements, you'll be able to purchase the new avatars as soon as the update goes live.My Room Improvements (Sep 23)Several quality-of-life improvements are coming to My Room.To help Masters discover a wider variety of rooms, the Take a Look feature will now show 10 randomly selected Mastersfrom among the top 100 Masters whose rooms are at least 80% full and gained the most Popularity over the past month.We're also adding a Preset feature that lets you save and reuse room setups from either your own My Room or another Master's.You can save up to 10 My Presets and 10 User Presets. Costumes and trophies will not be included when saving a preset.In addition, all nine My Room spaces will now be available by default.Masters who previously spent Deco Coins to unlock additional rooms will have those Deco Coins refunded.Achievement UI Improvements (Sep 23)A search function will be added to the Achievement screen, making it much easier to find specific achievements.You'll also be able to favorite achievements you want to keep track of and sort them by criteria such as completion rate and EXP reward.Simplified Cutscenes (Sep 23)We're adding a new Simplified Cutscene feature that briefly displays a character's costume illustration when they activate their skill.This setting will be separate from the existing full-screen Skill Cutscene option. Please note that Simplified Cutscenes cannot be skipped.With this update, illustrations previously used for Burst cut-ins will instead be used as the corresponding skill card image.Now, let's go over a few more changes coming in September.Increased Spark of Rampage from Shops & Content (Sep 10)The amount of Sparks of Rampage available from the Season Event, Guild, Golden Colosseum, and Mirror Wars shops, as well as Taros Tactical Manual, will be increased.Some shop prices will also be adjusted. If you've already purchased affected items, you'll receive a refund based on the amount you previously purchased during the September 23 maintenance.Withdrawal Restrictions During Guild Raid (Sep 10)If you borrow a character during an active Guild Raid, you will not be able to leave your Guild until the Guild Raid period has ended.Tutorial Guidebook Skip (Sep 10)A close button will be added to Guidebooks shown during tutorials, allowing you to exit without having to flip through every page.Skill Cutscene Adjustments for Select Costumes (Sep 10)The outfits shown in the skill cutscenes for the costumes below will be updated to match their standing illustrations.For Nebris, her facial expression/face will also be adjusted.Crimson Lotus Sylvia Cutscene Image: Before & AfterBeforeAfterNaive Lady Elise Cutscene Image: Before & AfterBeforeAfterLucky Bikini Nebris Cutscene Image: Before & AfterBeforeAfterBeforeAfterTerritory Pack Title Image Fix (Sep 10)We've cleaned up some visual inconsistencies in the image displayed when entering the Territory Pack.Next up, we'd like to give you a sneak peek at several new costumes and skins coming in October.We hope you'll look forward to what we have in store for October as well!Next, we'd like to go over some of the optimizations implemented in August.Fixed Memory Leak in Fiend HunterWe identified an issue in Fiend Hunter where memory used for cutscenes would continue to build up during gameplay.This could eventually cause the game to crash after repeated play, and the issue has now been fixed.Fixed Memory Leak in News/NoticeWe found that images used in the Notices and News displayed when launching the game were not being properly unloaded from memory.There was also an issue in the Event menu where selecting a banner would load all of the content displayed on the right side into memory.We've updated both areas so that memory is now released properly when it is no longer needed.Glupy Diner CPU Usage ImprovementsWe've fixed a memory management issue that occurred when NPCs moved around in Glupy Diner.Logging ImprovementsWe've reduced unnecessary logging that occurred during resource processing, helping to lower CPU load.Memory & CPU Usage ImprovementsWe've removed memory usage tied to unused splash screens, resulting in a small improvement to overall memory and CPU usage.We'll continue roadmap.Everything covered here is marked in green, and items with confirmed release plans have their target dates listed on the right.Items without a date are still in the planning and review stages, paragraphs: Hello, this is SooYeon Kim, Game Director of BrownDust2.
I had the chance to briefly introduce myself to all of you during the July 23 livestream.
Did you enjoy the broadcast?
Getting to spend the entire show together with our Masters made it a truly memorable experience for me.
I was also especially thrilled that we could finally reveal the new collaboration so many of you have been waiting for.
I know I still have a lot to learn, but I’ll continue doing my best to help make BrownDust2 an even more enjoyable experience for all of you.
Now, let’s take a look at what’s coming in this update.
BrownDust2’s fourth collaboration is...
『Chained Soldier 2』!!
The anime Chained Soldier 2 is set in Mato, an otherworldly realm where fierce battles unfold.
The series has won over fans with its distinctive cast of powerful characters, intense action, and gripping story.
For this collaboration, we wanted to bring the appeal of Chained Soldier 2 into BrownDust2 in a way that feels distinctly our own.
Our goal is to give longtime fans a fresh take on the characters they love, while also giving BrownDust2 Masters something completely new to enjoy.
The Chained Soldier 2 collaboration will run for approximately four weeks, from September 10 to October 7 (UTC).
Three characters from the series will be joining BrownDust2 as playable characters for the collaboration:
Kyouka Uzen, Tenka Izumo, and Ren Yamashiro.
New Characters & Costumes■ Kyouka Uzen
First up is Kyouka Uzen, commander of the Demon Defense Force's 7th Squad and wielder of Eternal Chains.
After the Shuuki destroyed her hometown, Kyouka devoted herself to wiping them out and set her sights on becoming Supreme Commander of the Demon Defense Force.
■ Tenka Izumo
Next is Tenka Izumo, commander of the Demon Defense Force's 6th Squad and wielder of Ame-no-Mitori.
Don't let her easygoing demeanor fool you. Her ability gives her terrifying control over space itself, allowing her to tear through both her enemies and the space around them.
■ Ren Yamashiro
Last is Ren Yamashiro, commander of the 10th Squad, Supreme Commander of the Demon Defense Force, and wielder of Lord of the Cosmos.
Her strength is on an entirely different level, earning her the title of "Earth's Answer" in the series.
All three will be joining BrownDust2 as new characters, along with their respective costumes.
These will all be limited collaboration costumes, available exclusively during the collaboration event.
We'll also be giving out six copies of Kyouka Uzen's costume for free.
In addition, Kyouka Uzen's exclusive UR gear, as well as the exclusive SR gear for all three collaboration costumes, will be available for free.
How to obtain Costume / Exclusive Gear by Character
Character and Costume Information
※ Pickup costumes and periods are subject to change, and these costumes may be resold or distributed through various channels in the future.
September Pickup Information
Collaboration Event Pack: Chained Soldier 2
The collaboration brings a brand-new Event Pack, Chained Soldier 2.
The story is set after Story Pack 20 but before Master Pack 1, so Master will not appear during the event.
After leaving the Black Gallery, Justia and her companions try to pass through Taros Mine on their way to Ghenar.
However, mysterious fiends appear and block their path.
Just as the party realizes that none of their attacks have any effect, Kyouka Uzen, commander of the Demon Defense Force's 7th Squad, appears before them.
What awaits Justia and her party after crossing paths with the Demon Defense Force? We hope you're looking forward to finding out!
While they won’t be available as costumes in this collaboration, members of the 7th and 6th Squads will still appear as NPCs.
Be sure to keep an eye out for Himari Azuma, Shushu Suruga, Nei Ookawamura, Yachiho Azuma, and Sahara Wakasa throughout the Event Pack!
Season Event
Two Season Events will run back-to-back during the collaboration, with each one available for two weeks.
■ Eternal Chains (Sep 10 - Sep 22)
Kicking things off alongside the collaboration is Eternal Chains, a Season Event themed around Chained Soldier 2.
■ Ancient Undead Miner (Sep 10)
Ancient Undead Miner arrives as a new fiend on September 10.
This Light-property enemy specializes in rapid multi-hit attacks over a small area and can reset its target's cooldown.
■ Time To Submit (Sep 23 - Oct 7)
The second half of the collaboration will have the Time To Submit Season Event.
■ Spirit of the Mines (Sep 23)
The Mine Spirit arrives as a new fiend on September 23.
This Dark-property enemy features battle mechanics built around taking advantage of the debuffs it inflicts.
New Special Skins
■ Special Date Tenka Izumo
Introducing Special Date, a new Special Skin for Tenka Izumo.
This skin offers a glimpse of Tenka enjoying some time off in a more casual look, away from her usual uniform.
■ Avatar
■ Skill Cutscene
■ Role Reversal Ren Yamashiro
Introducing Role Reversal, a new Special Skin for Ren Yamashiro.
This skin shows a very different side of Ren.
■ Avatar
■ Skill Cutscene

for either 1,000 Deco Coins or 2,000 Dia each.
Please note that collaboration avatars cannot equip the shared avatar items normally available through Avatar Settings.
Instead, they can only use the skin parts included with their respective Special Skins.
There are no restrictions on their emotes, content access, or other avatar features.
And finally, here's an early look at shots from Kyouka, Tenka, and Ren's skill cutscenes.
With the collaboration content covered, let's move on to the rest of the updates coming in September.
Character Pack 2 "Firechip" Slice of Life (Sep 10)
New Slice of Life stories are coming to Character Pack 2 "Firechip."
Look forward to catching up with familiar faces from Firechip, including Anastasia and Lecliss, and seeing what they've been up to.
Mini Season Event (Sep 23)
With autumn comes ripened harvests, a round full moon, and the return of our Mini Season Event.
This time, Master will join the characters of Dragonhaven and Westwind Village as they celebrate the Full Moon Festival together.
To mark the occasion, Master is invited to help make special moon rice cakes for the festival.
Will everyone manage to make them both delicious and pretty? You'll have to see for yourself!
We're also adding a set of quizzes based on details from the Slice of Life stories.
There will be five character quizzes featuring Glacia, Helena, Dalvi, Sylvia, and Yuri.
Complete the quizzes to earn currency, which can be exchanged for a variety of rewards in the Event Exchange (Dice Event).
Guild Raid■ Rucersingha (Dark) (Sep 23)
Starting September 23, Rucersingha will return as the next Guild Raid boss, this time with the Dark property.
The key to this battle will be chaining hits, as each hit adds another stack to a buff.
Personal Stories
New personal stories are on the way, starting with Whitebolt Yuri, followed by Desert Flower Sylvia and Thorn of the Desert Rubia.
We hope you'll look forward to seeing what stories each of them has to tell.
Next, let's take a look at the battle-related updates coming in September.
Tower of Salvation Daily Attempts Increased (Sep 10)
The number of free daily attempts in the Tower of Salvation will be increased from 3 to 10.
Free attempts will recharge each day at 9 AM (KST).

During these seasons, the following costumes will be banned: Comeback Idol Granhildr, Ocean Vanguard Luvencia, Neon Stalker Liatris, and Bittersweet Bunny Darian.
The blessings [Vanguard's Resolve], [Power of Agility], and [Price of Provocation] will also be banned.
Next, we'll go over the quality-of-life improvements coming in September.

The requirements for five ranking-related minigame achievements will also be made easier to complete.
Character-Based Backgrounds (Sep 10)
You'll now be able to assign a different background to each costume from the Costume Info and Replace Companion screens.
The background assigned to that costume will also be displayed when using Silhouette Mode.
Refill GluTalk Encounters (Sep 10)
* Images under development. Subject to change.
You can refill up to three additional GluTalk encounters per day using Dia or Deco Coins.
Encounters refilled with Deco Coins are not affected by the daily reset, so any unused encounters will carry over.
Character-Based Speech Bubbles (Sep 10)
Costumes set to appear in the field will now use their costume-specific dialogue instead of shared dialogue.
Only the unique dialogue for the first costume in the lineup will be displayed.

When refining gear, you'll now be able to select the target Gear Score you want to reach. The maximum number of repeat refinement attempts will also be increased from 1,000 to 5,000.
If you don't have enough resources to complete the full number of attempts you've selected, refinement will continue for as many attempts as your current resources allow.
Sticker Category Separation (Sep 10)
Stickers that were previously grouped together under the Special tab will now be split into separate categories.
The new categories are Special, Rapport, Emoji, and SFX, making it easier to find what you're looking for.

You'll now be able to borrow costumes from friends across all Story Pack difficulty levels.
This means friend costumes can also be used on Very Hard difficulty after the update.
New Home Menu Sorting Options (Sep 10)

In addition to the existing options, you'll be able to sort by things like most recent story or character, making it quicker to find exactly what you want for your Home Screen.
Improved Home BGM Player (Sep 10)
We're also improving how BGM album art is displayed on the Home Screen.
Some tracks currently share generic album art based on the Pack they belong to.
After the update, these tracks will instead display artwork that better reflects the content and theme they're actually associated with.
2 New Sky Island Mermaid Avatars (Sep 10)
Two new avatars will be available for purchase after completing the Flavia and Blanche fishing achievements in the new Sky Island fishing area.
If you've already completed these achievements, you'll be able to purchase the new avatars as soon as the update goes live.
My Room Improvements (Sep 23)
Several quality-of-life improvements are coming to My Room.
To help Masters discover a wider variety of rooms, the Take a Look feature will now show 10 randomly selected Masters
from among the top 100 Masters whose rooms are at least 80% full and gained the most Popularity over the past month.
We're also adding a Preset feature that lets you save and reuse room setups from either your own My Room or another Master's.
You can save up to 10 My Presets and 10 User Presets. Costumes and trophies will not be included when saving a preset.
In addition, all nine My Room spaces will now be available by default.
Masters who previously spent Deco Coins to unlock additional rooms will have those Deco Coins refunded.
Achievement UI Improvements (Sep 23)
A search function will be added to the Achievement screen, making it much easier to find specific achievements.
You'll also be able to favorite achievements you want to keep track of and sort them by criteria such as completion rate and EXP reward.
Simplified Cutscenes (Sep 23)
We're adding a new Simplified Cutscene feature that briefly displays a character's costume illustration when they activate their skill.
This setting will be separate from the existing full-screen Skill Cutscene option. Please note that Simplified Cutscenes cannot be skipped.
With this update, illustrations previously used for Burst cut-ins will instead be used as the corresponding skill card image.
Now, let's go over a few more changes coming in September.
Increased Spark of Rampage from Shops & Content (Sep 10)
The amount of Sparks of Rampage available from the Season Event, Guild, Golden Colosseum, and Mirror Wars shops, as well as Taros Tactical Manual, will be increased.
Some shop prices will also be adjusted. If you've already purchased affected items, you'll receive a refund based on the amount you previously purchased during the September 23 maintenance.
Withdrawal Restrictions During Guild Raid (Sep 10)
If you borrow a character during an active Guild Raid, you will not be able to leave your Guild until the Guild Raid period has ended.
Tutorial Guidebook Skip (Sep 10)
A close button will be added to Guidebooks shown during tutorials, allowing you to exit without having to flip through every page.
Skill Cutscene Adjustments for Select Costumes (Sep 10)
The outfits shown in the skill cutscenes for the costumes below will be updated to match their standing illustrations.
For Nebris, her facial expression/face will also be adjusted.

Next up, we'd like to give you a sneak peek at several new costumes and skins coming in October.
We hope you'll look forward to what we have in store for October as well!
Next, we'd like to go over some of the optimizations implemented in August.
Fixed Memory Leak in Fiend HunterWe identified an issue in Fiend Hunter where memory used for cutscenes would continue to build up during gameplay.
This could eventually cause the game to crash after repeated play, and the issue has now been fixed.
Fixed Memory Leak in News/Notice
We found that images used in the Notices and News displayed when launching the game were not being properly unloaded from memory.
There was also an issue in the Event menu where selecting a banner would load all of the content displayed on the right side into memory.
We've updated both areas so that memory is now released properly when it is no longer needed.
Glupy Diner CPU Usage Improvements
We've fixed a memory management issue that occurred when NPCs moved around in Glupy Diner.
Logging Improvements
We've reduced unnecessary logging that occurred during resource processing, helping to lower CPU load.
Memory & CPU Usage Improvements
We've removed memory usage tied to unused splash screens, resulting in a small improvement to overall memory and CPU usage.
We'll continue working to provide a smoother and more stable gameplay experience for all Masters.
Future Update Plans
Lastly, we'd like to share the latest progress on the remaining items in our update roadmap.
Everything covered here is marked in green, and items with confirmed release plans have their target dates listed on the right.
Items without a date are still in the planning and review stages, so their release schedules have not been finalized yet.

news.subject: 📋52nd Developer Notes: Addressing Recent Issues
news.contentPreview: Hello, everyone. This is Jun-hee Lee, Executive Producer of BrownDust 2.We have recently received many concerns and comments regarding various aspects of BrownDust 2.I sincerely apologize for the worr
news.body: Hello, everyone. This is Jun-hee Lee, Executive Producer of BrownDust 2.We have recently received many concerns and comments regarding various aspects of BrownDust 2.I sincerely apologize for the worry and disappointment these issues have caused.In this Developer Note, I would like to walk you through the key topics behind these discussions, detailing how these issues occurred and our plans for future improvement.Regarding Burst ImprovementsRegarding Burst Balance AdjustmentsThe four costumes where the Burst effect upgrade order was rearranged without numerical buffs areNew Hire Nebris, Homunculus Lathel, Ocean Vanguard Luvencia, and Naive Lady Elise.This adjustment was made after comprehensively reviewing actual usage data for Burst skills. We determined that these costumes were already performing at a high level, so we adjusted their unlock sequence while maintaining their overall performance.Unlike systems like Potentials, where you can select and prioritize specific abilities to upgrade, Burst requires sequential upgrades (Burst 1 → Burst 2 → Burst 3).Because of this structure, we placed noticeable, high-impact features—such as expanded skill range or additional hits—at Burst Level 1, while moving numerical boosts like ATK increases to later levels.In short, our intention was to ensure that costumes feel strong and effective starting at Burst Level 1 rather than requiring Burst Level 3 to be viable.This was meant to encourage players to strategically invest Spark of Rampage across a wider variety of characters for a more satisfying and rewarding experience.We will continue to monitor performance trends for each costume's Burst balance and include them in the costume balance adjustments we conduct every half-anniversary.Regarding Refinement and BurstThe Burst system was originally designed to mitigate performance gaps in combat caused by Refinement.However, looking at how progression ultimately reverts back to Refinement issues even after upgrading Burst, we recognize that Burst alone did not effectively solve this underlying problem.We take full responsibility for not thoroughly examining what issue we were attempting to solve when designing Burst, and whether our approach was actually effective.Despite adding a new progression element, we failed to deliver the meaningful change and enjoyment you expected, and caused confusion regarding our direction through repeated modifications.For this, we want to sincerely apologize.Moving forward, rather than remaining just a patch-up for Refinement issues, Burst will be improved into an independent system focused on its own distinct progression and tactical decision-making.Separately, we will re-examine current issues with Refinement from the perspective of revamping the system itself.During this process, our top priority will be ensuring that the time and resources you have invested in Refinement are not undermined.We will share more concrete plans through broadcasts or Developer Notes as soon as details take shape.Regarding Spark of Rampage AvailabilityPreviously, we took a conservative approach to Spark of Rampage sources because we believed that once player progress in the new Burst system stabilized, competition would revert back to Refinement.However, as mentioned earlier, moving forward, we intend to develop Burst as a separate, independent growth system rather than a means of compensating for issues with Refinement.In line with this, we are currently reviewing ways to increase the amount of Spark of Rampage obtainable through in-game content, aiming to complete this during the September updates.We apologize for causing confusion by failing to clearly define the roles and directions of these two progression systems.Going forward, we will address the issues of each system separately and improve them in line with their respective goals.Regarding AI UsagePV Production ProcessLet me first explain the production process of the Master Pack 2 PV.Storyboard Concept → Concept Art Rough Sketch → Color Grading → Camera Work → Animation → Visual Effects → Compositing → Sound Design → RenderingAs shown above, a single scene is completed through multiple production stages.Each element is then combined into the final PV format and undergoes an internal review before being released.There were indeed parts of this process where we received assistance from AI.We utilize AI when drafting initial storyboards or reviewing ideas, when creating certain background assets or extras, and when developing certain character motions.First, here is the initial background draft produced using AI, followed by the background illustration retouched and refined based on that draft.Next, here is an extra character draft created using AI, followed by the retouched and refined version.Finally, here are some of the character motions developed using AI.After utilizing AI, the final output is completed through the following process.Even when AI is utilized, generated drafts are not used as-is; they undergo subsequent retouching and compositing steps to reach the final output.We want to clarify that this video was not generated solely using AI; in fact, the vast majority of assets were produced manually by hand.Main characters, emotional facial close-ups, and key scenes are produced manually.Regardless of this process, presenting a final result of a quality that gave players the impression of being easily generated with AI is unquestionably our fault without excuse, and we sincerely apologize for this.We'd also like to share the work that was done purely by hand.Next is the background production process.For the backgrounds, we utilized 3D modeling, applying painterly texture maps that fit BrownDust 2's signature art style rather than standard 3D textures.The scene was completed through lighting adjustments followed by final compositing with concept art.Modeling StageLighting StageTexture Replacement Stage (crafted to fit BrownDust 2's art style)Step-by-step 3D Modeling WorkflowFinal Completed Scene (compositing character concept art with the 3D background)Our biggest oversight in producing this PV was causing players to question whether an official piece of content was generated via "one-click AI."AI will continue to be used strictly as an auxiliary tool, limited only to necessary areas.However, what matters more than the tool used is whether the final output reaches the quality standard that BrownDust 2 strives for.Going forward, rather than focusing solely on our production methods, we will apply much stricter standards to the overall quality and polish of the final product presented to you.Territory Pack Title Production ProcessLet me explain the production process that led to the release of the Territory Pack title art.While previous Story Packs and Character Packs featured 2D character illustrations for their title art, we used 3D modeling for the Territory Pack to capture the actual atmosphere and feel of the in-game territory.The images above are the raw 3D models implemented directly in the game.The background was built using 3D modeling, supplemented with AI assistance, and then completed through additional retouching.Existing 3D models of helper characters were directly placed onto the retouched background.This is the retouched image after character placement was completed.In this process, certain elements—such as the surrounding scenery, character props, and their action poses—did not blend together naturally.Unfortunately, retouching was wrapped up without sufficiently resolving these issues, ultimately lowering the quality of the final title art.For the Territory Pack title art, we will re-examine these awkward compositions and release a revised update.We apologize once again for the inconvenience caused.Regarding Content CensorshipPure White Blessing Refithea and Retired Legend Olivier are key examples modified according to regional regulations, while the 3rd Anniversary Justia Title was adjusted based on store guidelines.Based on these experiences, subsequent assets are designed to align with both regional regulations and store guidelines.However, the recent adjustments made to some content in Korea do not mean that we intend to apply Korean standards to all regions going forward.The baseline criteria we commonly apply follow regional laws alongside guidelines from storefronts where we operate, such as Google Play and the App Store.In particular, platform guidelines can sometimes be stricter than certain regional regulations, and we must comply with them in order to continue providing service through our existing platforms, including mobile stores.On the other hand, if certain content is allowed by the platform but conflicts with the laws or guidelines of a specific region, we will only adjust the level of expression for that region.Ultimately, the core issue is that the current review standards of Google Play and the App Store make it difficult to fully preserve the original level of expression that has been part of BrownDust2’s appeal.Therefore, we are preparing an alternative service model on platforms separate from Google and Apple—such as our standalone PC client and external storefronts—to preserve our original level of expression as much as possible.Naturally, we plan to set this up so that you can directly link and use the accounts you have been using on existing platforms.We are currently evaluating concrete plans for this and working hard so that we can present tangible results around our 3.5th Anniversary.While finding alternative ways to deliver our original level of expression is important, we will also continue seeking ways to maximize BrownDust 2's unique charm and creativity within permissible boundaries—much like the recent Sunny Inn Hand Helena costume's steamed buns.We sincerely apologize once again for causing concern and disappointment through the various changes regarding our content maturity levels.We know the explanations provided in this Developer Note won't instantly resolve every doubt or disappointment, but we promise to always ask ourselves whether our work lives up to BrownDust2's standards before presenting it to you.Once again, we sincerely apologize to all of you who were disappointed by these issues.We will continue doing our best to find the right balance between bold, appealing expression and stable service.Thank you.
paragraphs: Hello, everyone.
This is Jun-hee Lee, Executive Producer of BrownDust 2.
We have recently received many concerns and comments regarding various aspects of BrownDust 2.
I sincerely apologize for the worry and disappointment these issues have caused.
In this Developer Note, I would like to walk you through the key topics behind these discussions, detailing how these issues occurred and our plans for future improvement.
Regarding Burst Improvements
Regarding Burst Balance AdjustmentsThe four costumes where the Burst effect upgrade order was rearranged without numerical buffs are
New Hire Nebris, Homunculus Lathel, Ocean Vanguard Luvencia, and Naive Lady Elise.
This adjustment was made after comprehensively reviewing actual usage data for Burst skills.
We determined that these costumes were already performing at a high level, so we adjusted their unlock sequence while maintaining their overall performance.
Unlike systems like Potentials, where you can select and prioritize specific abilities to upgrade, Burst requires sequential upgrades (Burst 1 → Burst 2 → Burst 3).

Because of this structure, we placed noticeable, high-impact features—such as expanded skill range or additional hits—at Burst Level 1, while moving numerical boosts like ATK increases to later levels.
In short, our intention was to ensure that costumes feel strong and effective starting at Burst Level 1 rather than requiring Burst Level 3 to be viable.
This was meant to encourage players to strategically invest Spark of Rampage across a wider variety of characters for a more satisfying and rewarding experience.
We will continue to monitor performance trends for each costume's Burst balance and include them in the costume balance adjustments we conduct every half-anniversary.
Regarding Refinement and BurstThe Burst system was originally designed to mitigate performance gaps in combat caused by Refinement.
However, looking at how progression ultimately reverts back to Refinement issues even after upgrading Burst, we recognize that Burst alone did not effectively solve this underlying problem.
We take full responsibility for not thoroughly examining what issue we were attempting to solve when designing Burst, and whether our approach was actually effective.
Despite adding a new progression element, we failed to deliver the meaningful change and enjoyment you expected, and caused confusion regarding our direction through repeated modifications.
For this, we want to sincerely apologize.
Moving forward, rather than remaining just a patch-up for Refinement issues, Burst will be improved into an independent system focused on its own distinct progression and tactical decision-making.
Separately, we will re-examine current issues with Refinement from the perspective of revamping the system itself.
During this process, our top priority will be ensuring that the time and resources you have invested in Refinement are not undermined.
We will share more concrete plans through broadcasts or Developer Notes as soon as details take shape.
Regarding Spark of Rampage Availability
Previously, we took a conservative approach to Spark of Rampage sources because we believed that once player progress in the new Burst system stabilized, competition would revert back to Refinement.
However, as mentioned earlier, moving forward, we intend to develop Burst as a separate, independent growth system rather than a means of compensating for issues with Refinement.
In line with this, we are currently reviewing ways to increase the amount of Spark of Rampage obtainable through in-game content, aiming to complete this during the September updates.
We apologize for causing confusion by failing to clearly define the roles and directions of these two progression systems.
Going forward, we will address the issues of each system separately and improve them in line with their respective goals.
Regarding AI Usage
PV Production Process
Let me first explain the production process of the Master Pack 2 PV.
Storyboard Concept → Concept Art Rough Sketch → Color Grading → Camera Work → Animation → Visual Effects → Compositing → Sound Design → Rendering
As shown above, a single scene is completed through multiple production stages.
Each element is then combined into the final PV format and undergoes an internal review before being released.
There were indeed parts of this process where we received assistance from AI.
We utilize AI when drafting initial storyboards or reviewing ideas, when creating certain background assets or extras, and when developing certain character motions.
First, here is the initial background draft produced using AI, followed by the background illustration retouched and refined based on that draft.
Next, here is an extra character draft created using AI, followed by the retouched and refined version.
Finally, here are some of the character motions developed using AI.
After utilizing AI, the final output is completed through the following process.
Even when AI is utilized, generated drafts are not used as-is; they undergo subsequent retouching and compositing steps to reach the final output.
We want to clarify that this video was not generated solely using AI; in fact, the vast majority of assets were produced manually by hand.
Main characters, emotional facial close-ups, and key scenes are produced manually.

Regardless of this process, presenting a final result of a quality that gave players the impression of being easily generated with AI is unquestionably our fault without excuse, and we sincerely apologize for this.
We'd also like to share the work that was done purely by hand.
Next is the background production process.
For the backgrounds, we utilized 3D modeling, applying painterly texture maps that fit BrownDust 2's signature art style rather than standard 3D textures.
The scene was completed through lighting adjustments followed by final compositing with concept art.
Modeling Stage
Lighting Stage
Texture Replacement Stage (crafted to fit BrownDust 2's art style)
Step-by-step 3D Modeling Workflow
Final Completed Scene (compositing character concept art with the 3D background)
Our biggest oversight in producing this PV was causing players to question whether an official piece of content was generated via "one-click AI."
AI will continue to be used strictly as an auxiliary tool, limited only to necessary areas.
However, what matters more than the tool used is whether the final output reaches the quality standard that BrownDust 2 strives for.
Going forward, rather than focusing solely on our production methods, we will apply much stricter standards to the overall quality and polish of the final product presented to you.
Territory Pack Title Production Process
Let me explain the production process that led to the release of the Territory Pack title art.

While previous Story Packs and Character Packs featured 2D character illustrations for their title art, we used 3D modeling for the Territory Pack to capture the actual atmosphere and feel of the in-game territory.
The images above are the raw 3D models implemented directly in the game.
The background was built using 3D modeling, supplemented with AI assistance, and then completed through additional retouching.
Existing 3D models of helper characters were directly placed onto the retouched background.
This is the retouched image after character placement was completed.
In this process, certain elements—such as the surrounding scenery, character props, and their action poses—did not blend together naturally.
Unfortunately, retouching was wrapped up without sufficiently resolving these issues, ultimately lowering the quality of the final title art.
For the Territory Pack title art, we will re-examine these awkward compositions and release a revised update.
We apologize once again for the inconvenience caused.
Regarding Content Censorship
Pure White Blessing Refithea and Retired Legend Olivier are key examples modified according to regional regulations, while the 3rd Anniversary Justia Title was adjusted based on store guidelines.
Based on these experiences, subsequent assets are designed to align with both regional regulations and store guidelines.
However, the recent adjustments made to some content in Korea do not mean that we intend to apply Korean standards to all regions going forward.
The baseline criteria we commonly apply follow regional laws alongside guidelines from storefronts where we operate, such as Google Play and the App Store.

In particular, platform guidelines can sometimes be stricter than certain regional regulations, and we must comply with them in order to continue providing service through our existing platforms, including mobile stores.
On the other hand, if certain content is allowed by the platform but conflicts with the laws or guidelines of a specific region, we will only adjust the level of expression for that region.

Ultimately, the core issue is that the current review standards of Google Play and the App Store make it difficult to fully preserve the original level of expression that has been part of BrownDust2’s appeal.

Therefore, we are preparing an alternative service model on platforms separate from Google and Apple—such as our standalone PC client and external storefronts—to preserve our original level of expression as much as possible.
Naturally, we plan to set this up so that you can directly link and use the accounts you have been using on existing platforms.
We are currently evaluating concrete plans for this and working hard so that we can present tangible results around our 3.5th Anniversary.

While finding alternative ways to deliver our original level of expression is important, we will also continue seeking ways to maximize BrownDust 2's unique charm and creativity within permissible boundaries—much like the recent Sunny Inn Hand Helena costume's steamed buns.
We sincerely apologize once again for causing concern and disappointment through the various changes regarding our content maturity levels.

We know the explanations provided in this Developer Note won't instantly resolve every doubt or disappointment, but we promise to always ask ourselves whether our work lives up to BrownDust2's standards before presenting it to you.
Once again, we sincerely apologize to all of you who were disappointed by these issues.
We will continue doing our best to find the right balance between bold, appealing expression and stable service.
Thank you.
